java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.core.comands.CommandParameterInfo<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the parameter.
Record Components:
name - the name of the parameter.
clz - the class of the parameter.
public record CommandParameterInfo<T>(String name, Class<T> clz) extends Record
Record that holds the name and class of a command parameter with some utility methods.
